program.name: Strength & Yoga Flow
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: Supersets for strength, then a yoga flow: standing poses after upper days, floor poses after lower.
program.about: Strength in supersets, then a real yoga flow. Upper days pair presses with rows and finish on standing poses, warriors and twists; lower days pair squats with hinges and finish on the floor, folds, bridges and hip openers. The flow is long enough to feel like yoga, not a cool-down. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Upper supersets & standing flow / lower supersets & floor flow
